sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2019 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 Coupe 3ZR ZTK, finished in Torch Red with a Jet Black interior, and auctioned in collaboration with Mothers High Performance Car Care. Journalist and Cars & Bids founder Doug DeMuro recently reviewed this Corvette, and the video is viewable below. This ZR1 features the desirable 7-speed manual transmission and ZTK Track Performance Package, and the odometer currently displays approximately 7,100 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Corvette’s past. It also shows that this car has been registered in California to one corporate owner (Mothers) since new. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this Corvette cost $143,955 new, including over $21,900 in options. A partial list of notable equipment includes the 3ZR Premium Equipment Group, the ZTK Track Performance and Carbon Fiber Dual Roof packages, Competition sport seats, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to a Callaway S4 short-throw shifter and a dealer-installed 50-state legal GM Performance air induction kit. Chevrolet launched the seventh-generation (C7) Corvette for the 2014 model year. It offered a more user-friendly interior, a sharper-looking exterior design, and, significantly, the then-new LT1 small-block V8. The ZR1 pelted the Corvette nameplate into supercar territory with an Eaton supercharger, an aggressive aerodynamic package that generated 70% more downforce than the Z06, and a race car-like suspension system. Power comes from an LT5 6.2-liter supercharged V8, rated at 755 horsepower and 715 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed manual transmission.
sections.Equipment: The manufacturer's original window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: 3ZR Premium Equipment Group (memory package, power bolster and lumbar adjustment, Napa leather upholstery, heated, power-adjustable, and auto-dimming side view mirrors, auto-dimming rearview mirror, satellite radio connectivity, sueded microfiber-wrapped upper trim package, leather-wrapped instrument panel and doors, heated and ventilated seats, universal home remote, performance data and video recorder, navigation system, advanced theft deterrent system, front curb-view cameras, high-gloss carbon fiber interior trim, carbon fiber and leather-wrapped steering wheel) ZTK Track Performance Package (Performance Ride and Handling suspension, adjustable high-wing spoiler, front splitter end caps) Carbon Fiber Dual Roof Package (Carbon fiber and transparent removable roof panels) 19-inch front and 20-inch rear Satin Graphite-painted aluminum wheels Brembo carbon-ceramic brakes with red-painted calipers Carbon flash painted spoiler and outside mirrors Competition sport seats Red seat belts and leather stitching
sections.Seller Notes: The seller reports that paint protection film has been applied to select panels, including the front bumper, side view mirrors, front splitters, vertical winglets, side skirts, and the carbon fiber engine cover.
